tickets.title: Compare first-year college funding sources for Nia Dewspindle
tickets.text: Prepare a comparison of funding sources to cover Nia Dewspindle's first-year college funding gap at Marzipan Meadow University, including Nia's 529 balance (about $74,600), the joint taxable brokerage at Velvet Acorn Custody (about $412,000), expected bonus cash from Liora's 22% target bonus on her $185,000 base salary at Cloudberry Kite Robotics, and a limited sale of Cloudberry Kite Robotics shares (about $118,000 position, about $42,000 cost basis). Preserve the $80,000 cash reserve floor at Teacup Comet Bank.
tickets.evidence: They agreed that by 2026-03-20 a comparison will be prepared of using Nia’s 529 balance, taxable brokerage assets, expected bonus cash, and a limited sale of Cloudberry Kite Robotics shares to cover the first-year college funding gap while preserving Liora’s stated cash reserve floor.

tickets.title: Select Marzipan Meadow University tuition payment method
tickets.text: Help Liora and Dorian Dewspindle select the Marzipan Meadow University tuition payment method (semester lump-sum or monthly payment plan) so the first bill can be processed before the 2026-04-15 deadline.
tickets.evidence: A tuition payment method selection is needed by 2026-04-15 because the Marzipan Meadow University portal offers a semester lump-sum payment or monthly payment plan, and the family has not chosen the method needed before the first bill can be processed.

tickets.title: Obtain current 529 statements for Nia, Owen, and grandparent account
tickets.text: Obtain current statements for Nia Dewspindle's 529 account, Owen Dewspindle's 529 account, and the grandparent-owned education account Dorian Dewspindle mentioned, so account ownership, balances, and available distribution options can be confirmed for the planning file.
tickets.evidence: Current statements for Nia’s 529 account, Owen’s 529 account, and a grandparent-owned education account Dorian mentioned are needed by 2026-03-18 because the planning file lacks them and account ownership, balances, and available distribution options cannot be confirmed.

tickets.title: Reconcile Nia Dewspindle 529 balance discrepancy
tickets.text: Reconcile the discrepancy in Nia Dewspindle's 529 balance, where Liora's tuition spreadsheet lists about $82,000 while the portal statement shows about $74,600 after a prior distribution, and identify the source of the difference.
tickets.evidence: They agreed to reconcile the 529 balance by 2026-03-18 because Liora’s tuition spreadsheet lists Nia’s 529 balance at about $82,000, while the portal statement shows about $74,600 after a prior distribution, and the source of the difference was not identified during the call.

tickets.text: Review the Dewspindle college cost worksheet to separate scholarship aid, required technology costs, housing charges, and tuition so amounts can be matched to education account distributions and tax records.
